maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue: The tunnel widens, and the stench of sulfur grows with every step. You can hear the distant rumble of fire, like a giant's heartbeat.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-10: The site lies before a heavy stone door leading deeper into the lair. The walls tremble with a low, distant rumble. Heat seeps through the cracks.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-100: The tunnel opens into a broad, carved hall. Five stone platforms rise from the floor, each marked with faintly glowing runes. A heavy stone door bars the path ahead.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-101: "Stone and smoke..." Korr mutters, tracing the cracks in the wall. "This wasn't on the map. Some kind of lock or worse, a puzzle."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-102: He exhales sharply and glances your way, eyes narrowing beneath the soot and sweat.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-103: "Well, lad, here's your chance to prove yourself. Let's see what you're made of."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-104: The air grows colder as faint blue lights emerge from the darkness. Dim, steady, still burning after centuries.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-105: Their glow does not belong to the dragon's lair.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-106: Whatever this place is, it was here long before the dragon ever arrived.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-11: Korr sets down the barrel with a grunt and wipes the sweat from his brow. "Aye, here's the place," he says, running a hand along the wall. "Right before its den. We'll make sure it wakes to thunder."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-13: Choose “Try to reason with Korr.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-14: You try to speak, but Korr cuts you off, his voice rough and impatient.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-15: "No turning back now," he growls. "We're too deep for doubts."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-16: You speak louder this time, over the rumble of the stone. For a heartbeat his eyes flicker then harden again.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-17: "If we stop now, all this was for nothing," he mutters.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-18: You block his path and meet his eyes. The glow of the fissure paints his face in red.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-19: "Enough," you say. "Durok asked that the wyrm be spared. I won't see it slain, we'll bring the roof down without killing the beast."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-2: Korr grins through his soot-streaked beard, eyes gleaming in the torchlight.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-20: Korr exhales and nods. "No explosives then. We'll bring him down by other means. I'll follow your lead."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-22: The passage widens into a vast cavern. The ground glitters with scattered coins, broken armor, and bones. The air hangs thick. Hot, heavy, and stinking of sulfur.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-23: "So this is it," Korr mutters, squinting into the haze. "The beast's den. Smaller than I imagined but its flame'll cook us just the same."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-24: A shadow shifts beyond the glow. Scales catch the firelight, wings unfold, and a roar rolls through the cavern like a storm breaking stone.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-25: "Baraz-dum!" Korr bellows, the dwarven warcry echoing against the cavern walls. "For Dun Kareth! For the forge!"
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-26: Choose “Place the barrel.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-27: You help drag the barrel into position. Korr drives a metal spike through the lid and secures the fuse. The rock beneath your feet hums with tension.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-28: "Durok always said the mountain had a pulse... I can hear it now." he says quietly.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-3: 'There it is,' he says. 'The beast's lair ahead. Smell that? By the forge, that's the scent of victory.'
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-30: You wipe the dust from your hands and glance back toward Korr.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-31: You and the dwarves press into the shadows, finding a narrow crevice to hide behind. Korr thumbs the fuse, eyes hard.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-32: "Wake the mountain," he whispers, and with a single motion he sets the line aflame.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-33: The charges detonate. The ground shakes violently as huge sections of the ceiling collapse into the dragon's lair.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-34: Dust fills the passage. As the dwarves push through the rubble, something massive begins to move in the ruined lair ahead.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-36: A massive shape heaves upward from the rubble. Scales torn, wings scorched, blood steaming in the heat. The dragon roars, fury and pain blending into one deafening scream.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-37: The path ends at a heavy stone door, warm with soot.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-38: "This'll rattle its teeth," he says with a grin. "Best spot we'll get."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-39: The path ends before a heavy stone door veined with heat and soot. Korr steadies the barrel at their base and leans in close. "This'll rattle its teeth." He grins through the heat. "Best spot we'll get."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-4:
He patted a wooden barrel tied to his backpack, He let out a rough laugh.“
These treasures need to be placed in three good locations. Solid stones, Get close to the pit where the dragon sleeps. We certainly don’t want to drag barrels of thunder down to the ground and waste them!”
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-40: You start to argue, but Korr's glare stops you cold.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-41: "No turning back now," he snaps. "We're too deep for doubts."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-42: You raise your voice again, pointing to the cracks forming around you. Dust trickles down, and Korr hesitates only for a heartbeat.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-43: "If we stop now, all this was for nothing," he mutters, more to himself than to you.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-44: You brace the barrel between cracked stones. The air reeks of sulfur and old fire. Korr sets the fuse with shaking fingers.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-45: "Durok said the mountain had a pulse... I hear it now."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-46: You step back as the heat shimmers through the narrow passage.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-47: The tunnel tightens around a scorched stone door. Heat leaks through the cracks. Korr sets the barrel down nearby, firelight flickering across his armor.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-48: "We're close to its heart," he says quietly. "One spark here will bring the ceiling down and seal its escape."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-49: The tunnel narrows before ending at a scorched stone door. Heat seeps through the cracks, turning the air heavy and dry. Korr lowers the barrel, the firelight dancing across his armor.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-5: Event opening (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” Not currently in progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-50: "This one's close to the heart of it," Korr breathes, voice taut. "Should bring the whole ceiling down and seal its escape for good."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-51: You try to speak, but Korr's patience snaps like brittle stone.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-52: "No turning back now!" he shouts. "If we stop, the wyrm wins and we burn all the same!"
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-53: You call out to him again, your words nearly lost in the thunder of the mountain. He freezes mid-step, jaw clenched.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-54: "If this goes wrong, the whole mountain comes down," you warn.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-55: "Maybe it's time the mountain did," he growls, forcing the barrel forward.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-56: You set the barrel by the molten fissure, the heat biting through your armor. Korr watches, the glow cutting sharp lines across his face.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-57: "The mountain's angry," Korr growls under his breath. "Too much heat... too much power."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-58: You wipe the sweat from your brow and glance toward the tunnels beyond.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-59: You walk down the narrow corridor. The heat, the echo of your boots, all the same as before. Suddenly, everything feels strangely familiar.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-6: A heavy stone door blocks the path ahead, warm air leaking through the cracks. The mountain rumbles, slow and deep.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-60: A few more steps, and your torchlight falls upon the same cracked pillar you passed minutes ago. The same scorch marks. The same air. You're back where you started.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-61: "What-?" Korr stops mid-step, glaring down the hall. "We just walked this damned path!"
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-62: He curses under his breath, running a hand along the wall, then slams his fist against the stone. "By the Forge! Some kind of enchantment. Hidden teleport, most likely. Typical wizard's trick. There must be a hidden switch somewhere... Keep your eyes on the walls, lad."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-63: Korr's eyes flare with fury. "Stone and smoke! Again? These blasted tricks are testing my patience." He growls, gripping his axe.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-64: "If this hall loops one more time, I'll start carving my own bloody tunnel."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-65: "Grumvek. Blocked." Korr mutters, running a gloved hand across the cracked wall. "No point wasting time. We'll take another route."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-66: Event opening (Quests “The Last Forge Burns” In progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-67: The cavern splits with a thunderclap of stone. The dragon writhes once, then falls.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-68: The shockwave hurls you and the dwarves to the ground. When the smoke clears, the wyrm lies crushed beneath the fallen rubble.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-69: For a moment there is nothing but silence. Then Korr staggers to his feet, his armor blackened, his beard singed and matted with ash.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-7: Korr drops the barrel and wipes his brow. "Aye, this is the spot," he says. "Right before its den. We'll wake it with thunder."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-70: "Khazrad barum..." he breathes, voice trembling. "By forge and fatherstone... we've slain the dragon."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-71: He looks upon the corpse. Awe, fear, and pride twisting together. "No king ever forged a tale like this."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-72: The dwarves gather around, their cheers echoing through the halls. Helmets raised, they shout the name of Korr, of Dun Kareth.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-73: The last tremor fades. For the first time, the mountain is quiet.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-74: Korr turns to you, his grin wild, his eyes hollow. "Aye, we did it," he says. "Stone bear witness... and may it forgive us."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-75: Event opening (Quests “The Last Forge Burns” Not currently in progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-76: The dragon crashes down with a roar that tears through the mountain. Fire bursts from its jaws, spilling across the stone before fading into embers. The ground splits and groans beneath its weight.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-77: You stumble back as a wave of heat rolls past. The dragon convulses once more, its massive claws scraping against the stone.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-78: At last, the beast lies still. Its broken wings stretch across the shattered cavern floor.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-79: For a long moment, you simply stand there, staring at the dead dragon.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-80: A deep groan rolls through the cavern. One by one, the shattered pillars crumble into dust. The ceiling cracks open, and streams of molten light rain down from above.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-81: The ground tilts beneath your feet. Stones tumble, tunnels twist, and the roar of collapsing rock drowns out all other sound.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-82: Through the smoke and falling debris, the wyrm rises - bloodied but defiant. Its wings unfurl, scattering shards of stone and ash.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-83: It turns its burning eyes toward you. Then, with a thunderous sweep, bursts upward through the collapsing vault. The air howls as the dragon breaks free and vanishes into the storm above.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-84: The tremors fade. What remains of the lair sinks into silence and drifting ash.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-85: Korr stands motionless, staring at the widening crack in the ceiling. The light from above paints his face gold and grey all at once.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-86: "It's gone," he mutters, voice low. "All that fire... and it still got away."
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-87: He lets out a rough laugh. "Aye... maybe that's for the best," he adds quietly.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-88: You watch the last flakes of ash settle. The dragon escaped, and the mountain stands.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-89: The cavern yawns open before you, heat rolling like a forge left to burn. You came here ahead of Korr's warband. The wyrm waits.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-9: Event opening (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” In progress)
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-90: A low tremor rolls through the ground. Dust drifts from the ceiling as something massive moves in the dark depths.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-91: Two points of molten light flare open ahead. Eyes, ancient and burning with slow, unending fury. A growl follows, deep and endless, shaking the very bones of the mountain.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-92: The dragon awakens, scales grinding against the stone, its breath a furnace wind that fills the cavern with living fire.

maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-95: The tunnel opens into a vast cave, thick with heat and the stench of ash. The walls gleam like dark iron.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-96: Across the cavern lie scattered hoards. Diamonds, old weapons, dented helms, and piles of coins half buried in soot.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-97: Two points of molten light flare open ahead. Eyes. Ancient, and burning with slow fury.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-98: A deep growl follows, rolling through the stone like distant thunder.
maps.points.dragon_den.dialogue-99: The dragon moves. Scales scrape against stone as its massive body shifts in the dark.
